summary: Tested OPS backend critical flows and frontend desktop/mobile smoke flows against the public preview.

issues: Login stores bearer token in localStorage and does not establish an httpOnly cookie; review auth hardening requirement.

action_items: Add unique data-testid attributes to each mobile menu navigation button.
Consider httpOnly cookie session auth if required by the authentication playbook; current flow exposes JWT in localStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile menu buttons render without data-testid despite the requirement that all interactive elements have stable unique IDs.
Frontend hero uses an external Unsplash image URL, conflicting with design_guidelines media policy requiring archive-provided assets; reference archive was unavailable.
seed_data_creation: Created one test ride and one rental through existing seeded rider/driver/admin accounts; no manual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend lifecycle test created a rider ride, captain accepted/progressed/completed it, and rider submitted feedback. Preview has no horizontal overflow at 390px or 1920px. Mobile Safety navigation and unauthenticated booking error passed.
rca of the issue: The mobile menu maps navigation items to plain buttons without data-testid, while desktop equivalents have IDs. Auth implementation persists JWT in localStorage (App.js) and sends Authorization headers; no cookie is set by /api/auth/login. This is a security/playbook compliance concern, not a functional login failure.
